literal_meaning: একবারে তুড়ি (ছোট বস্তু বা বান্ডিল) এর মতো দ্রুত
figurative_meaning_en: effortlessly; very easily; in a moment
similar_in_english: in the blink of an eye
at the snap of a finger
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একতুড়িতে সমস্যার সমাধান করে দিল।
example_sentences_in_english: He solved the problem in a trice.
The exam preparation was done effortlessly.
note: This idiom emphasizes instantaneous action, common in colloquial Bengali.
